edits.why: Tokens come from maude-v2. The v2 component sheet loads last, so .btn, .input, .seg, .switch, .chip and .kbd take the v2 look. The old sheet stays only as a bridge for classes v2 doesn't have (.panel, .tree-row, .tabbar/.tab, .callout, .btn--icon). It now draws them with v2 tokens.
The canvas header names its design system. It should match the meta.

notes: Every var(--…) token in this canvas also exists in maude-v2, so no token is renamed.

Classes that v2 doesn't have, used here: .panel (line 130), .tree-row (152–158), .btn--icon (252), .tabbar/.tab (257–259), .callout/.callout--info/.callout--warn (320–373). They keep their old anatomy through the bridge import.
The theme stays forced to dark (Shell wrapper, line 399). maude-v2 is light-first, and its dark theme is an equal option.
Not in this switch: the layout docks the panel in a full-height shell (menubar + sidebar). That breaks maude-v2's rule 'Chrome floats; it never frames.' Fixing it is a redesign.
The inline Mark (lines 53–60) keeps its bg-3 tile. maude-v2's logo uses an --accent tile with an --accent-fg star.
The header comment's prose (lines 11–15) still says 'Authored under the maude DS'. The comment in the sibling GitPanel.css does too. Both are text only and don't change the render.
